Given the agent does provide a correlational cause but frames it as unconfirmed, and extensively documents the telemetry gaps (LLM-TEL-001, LLM-TEL-003) as limiting ground truth diagnosis, this closely matches the expected root cause's emphasis. It's not a perfect one-to-one match (missing explicit LLM-TEL-002 discussion), but the substance aligns.
